title: Whole Pointed Acorn with Thick Cupule
description: One complete static stylised woodland acorn-like fruit, not a separated nut and reusable bowl. A newly profiled plump tapered pointed nut is continuously enclosed at its rear by a thick bounded scalloped cupule whose narrow woody stalk is part of that same closed material mesh. The cap rim and nut genuinely embed at selected material points; the real cup interior is occupied by the nut and is not claimed to be empty. The small finite nut underside supports the complete fruit, not a point touch. Two complete material meshes, one prop, zero scenes. All geometry newly authored, no removed samara wing, reused pine-cone scale or extracted bean cotyledon. No exact species, growth, edible identification, shell mechanics or botanical internal anatomy claim. Metres, Z-up, true whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin.
